scope: Small file-bound guard/result metadata writer for a single stabilization run
cause: The immutable screenshot-guest-001 receipt reused the SHA-256 digest of the Debug 006 guard log. The actual screenshot guard log and private result files are still available; the audit does not establish how the wrong digest was copied.
contract: The tool reads both exact files and computes each SHA-256 from its bytes. It refuses a guard with missing, duplicate, or mismatched RESOURCE_ADMITTED/RESOURCE_JOB_EXIT run IDs and writes a new mode-0600 JSON file with exclusive creation. It emits only paths, hashes, bounded guard timestamps/exit code, a classified raw-result status, and validated build version/tree if present; it copies no child stdout or private result payload. It never accepts a caller-supplied digest or edits an existing receipt.
verification: A light unit guard covers wrong-run refusal before output creation and independently recomputed digests for two distinct raw files, along with payload omission and no-overwrite behavior. Root owns the guarded test run and the separate correction artifact; this lane has not launched a browser, build, or test.
boundary: The generated metadata corrects provenance only. It does not promote an inventory case, defect state, or product acceptance result.
